title: Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification (Sixth Revision)
scope: Covers Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC) available in five grades: OPC 33, OPC 43, OPC 53, OPC 43S and OPC 53S. Used for general structural concrete, masonry mortar, plastering, and non-structural applications. Specifies requirements for fineness, setting time, soundness, and compressive strength. Performance improvers such as fly ash, slag, silica fume and limestone may be added at grinding stage up to 5% by mass.
keywords: ordinary portland cement OPC 33 grade 43 grade 53 grade cement construction mortar plaster concrete masonry general purpose

title: 43 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for 43-grade Ordinary Portland Cement used in structural concrete, reinforced concrete, prestressed concrete, and precast concrete products. Covers chemical composition, fineness, setting time, soundness, and minimum compressive strength of 43 MPa at 28 days.
keywords: OPC 43 grade ordinary portland cement structural concrete reinforced concrete precast construction

title: 53 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification
scope: Covers high-strength 53-grade Ordinary Portland Cement used in prestressed concrete, high-performance concrete structures, bridges, and other works requiring early high strength. Specifies minimum compressive strength of 53 MPa at 28 days, fineness, setting time, and soundness requirements.
keywords: OPC 53 grade high strength cement prestressed concrete bridge construction high performance

title: Portland Slag Cement — Specification (Fifth Revision)
scope: Portland Slag Cement (PSC) is manufactured by intergrinding OPC clinker with granulated blast-furnace slag. Offers high resistance to chloride and sulphate attack. Suitable for marine structures, ports, harbours, sewage treatment plants, canal lining, tunnels, piling and basement works. Specifies slag content, fineness, setting time, soundness and strength requirements.
keywords: portland slag cement PSC blast furnace slag construction marine sulphate resistant blended cement

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement — Specification: Part 1 Fly Ash Based (Fourth Revision)
scope: Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC) — Fly Ash Based. Produced by intergrinding or blending OPC clinker with fly ash conforming to IS 3812. Used in mass concrete, structures in aggressive chemical environments, marine works and general construction. Covers fly ash content limits, fineness, setting time, soundness and compressive strength.
keywords: portland pozzolana cement PPC fly ash blended cement construction marine works mass concrete

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement — Specification: Part 2 Calcined Clay Based (Fourth Revision)
scope: Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC) — Calcined Clay Based. Produced using calcined clay as the pozzolanic material. Suitable for general construction and works requiring moderate sulphate resistance. Specifies calcined clay content, fineness, setting time, soundness and strength requirements.
keywords: portland pozzolana cement PPC calcined clay blended cement construction moderate sulphate resistance

title: Specification for Masonry Cement (Second Revision)
scope: Masonry cement used for general purposes where mortars for masonry work are required but not intended for structural concrete. Specifies composition, fineness, setting time, water retentivity and compressive strength for use in brick-laying, plastering and rendering applications.
keywords: masonry cement brickwork mortar plastering rendering general construction non-structural

title: Specification for High Alumina Cement for Structural Use (First Revision)
scope: High Alumina Cement (HAC) for structural use. Manufactured by fusing or sintering a mixture of aluminous and calcareous materials. Develops very high early strength and good resistance to acidic conditions and elevated temperatures. Used in refractory concrete and structures requiring rapid strength gain.
keywords: high alumina cement HAC refractory concrete rapid strength acidic conditions structural cement

title: Specification for Supersulphated Cement (First Revision)
scope: Supersulphated Cement is manufactured by grinding a mixture of granulated blast-furnace slag with calcium sulphate and Portland cement clinker. Suitable for marine works, piling, underwater construction and aggressive ground conditions. Resistant to sulphate attack and suitable for aggressive water conditions. Specifies composition, fineness, setting time, soundness and strength.
keywords: supersulphated cement marine piling underwater sulphate resistant aggressive ground construction

title: Specification for Rapid Hardening Portland Cement (Second Revision)
scope: Rapid Hardening Portland Cement (RHPC) achieves high early compressive strength, suitable for precast concrete, cold-weather construction, repair works and situations requiring early stripping of formwork. Specifies a minimum compressive strength significantly higher than OPC at 72 hours.
keywords: rapid hardening cement RHPC early strength precast concrete repair cold weather formwork

title: White Portland Cement — Specification (Third Revision)
scope: White Portland Cement is manufactured from raw materials with low iron and manganese content to produce white-coloured cement. Used for architectural, decorative and aesthetic concrete work including tiles, terrazzo flooring, white concrete panels and ornamental structures. Specifies whiteness index, fineness, setting time, soundness and strength.
keywords: white portland cement decorative architectural terrazzo tiles ornamental concrete aesthetic

title: White Portland Cement — Specification
scope: White Portland Cement used for decorative and architectural concrete work. Manufactured with low iron and manganese content. Used for tiles, terrazzo flooring, ornamental structures, and white concrete finishes.
keywords: white cement portland cement decorative architectural concrete tiles

title: Specification for Hydrophobic Portland Cement
scope: Hydrophobic Portland Cement is produced by grinding OPC clinker with a film-forming water-repelling substance (e.g., oleic acid). The hydrophobic coating prevents deterioration during long storage in humid conditions. Used where cement must be stored for extended periods before use.
keywords: hydrophobic cement storage humid long storage water repellent portland cement

title: Specification for Oil-well Cement
scope: Oil-well Cement is specially designed for cementing steel casings in oil and gas wells at high temperatures and pressures. Specifies chemical composition, fineness, thickening time, compressive strength and consistency requirements for different temperature and pressure grades.
keywords: oil well cement oilfield casing high temperature high pressure petroleum cement

title: Specification for Sulphate Resisting Portland Cement
scope: Sulphate Resisting Portland Cement (SRPC) provides high resistance to sulphate attack. Used in foundations, basements, sewers, marine structures and soils or ground water with high sulphate content. Specifies maximum tricalcium aluminate (C3A) and tetracalcium aluminoferrite (C4AF) contents.
keywords: sulphate resisting cement SRPC foundation basement sewer marine sulphate soil aggressive ground

title: Specification for Low Heat Portland Cement
scope: Low Heat Portland Cement (LHPC) generates less heat of hydration during setting and hardening. Suitable for mass concrete structures such as large dams, foundations and thick retaining walls where thermal cracking is a risk. Specifies maximum heat of hydration limits at 7 and 28 days.
keywords: low heat cement LHPC dam mass concrete retaining wall thermal cracking heat hydration

title: Composite Cement — Specification
scope: Composite Cement is a blended cement containing OPC clinker with two or more supplementary cementitious materials (fly ash, slag, silica fume, limestone, etc.). Designed to optimise properties including strength, durability and reduced carbon footprint. Specifies constituent proportions, fineness, strength and expansion limits.
keywords: composite cement blended cement fly ash slag silica fume limestone supplementary cementitious material

title: Microfine Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification
scope: Microfine Ordinary Portland Cement (MOPC) has a much finer particle size than standard OPC. Used for grouting fine cracks and fissures in rock, concrete and masonry where conventional cement grout cannot penetrate. Specifies particle size distribution, Blaine fineness and strength requirements.
keywords: microfine cement grouting crack fissure rock masonry penetration fine particle cement

title: Portland Calcined Clay Limestone Cement — Specification
scope: Portland Calcined Clay Limestone Cement (LC3) is a low-clinker blended cement incorporating calcined clay and limestone as supplementary materials. Reduces CO2 emissions compared to OPC. Provides good strength and durability for general construction. Specifies clinker content, calcined clay reactivity, expansion limits and mechanical properties.
keywords: LC3 calcined clay limestone cement low clinker low carbon green cement construction

title: Coarse and Fine Aggregates for Concrete — Specification
scope: Specifies the quality and grading requirements for coarse and fine aggregates obtained from natural, manufactured, or recycled sources for use in structural concrete. Covers particle size distribution, deleterious materials, aggregate crushing value, impact value, and soundness.
keywords: coarse aggregate fine aggregate sand gravel crushed stone concrete mix construction grading particle size

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for high-strength deformed steel bars and wires (TMT bars) used as reinforcement in concrete structures. Covers grades Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, and Fe 600. Includes requirements for tensile strength, yield strength, elongation, and bend test.
keywords: TMT bars steel reinforcement rebars Fe415 Fe500 Fe550 Fe600 deformed bars reinforced concrete RCC construction

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for hot-rolled structural steel used in bridges, buildings, general structural fabrication and engineering purposes. Covers grades E250, E300, E350, E410, E450, and E550 in various sub-grades based on impact properties. Applicable for plates, sections, flats, and bars.
keywords: structural steel hot rolled plates sections bridges buildings structural members fabrication welded E250 E350 general engineering

title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice
scope: General code of practice covering the design and construction of plain, reinforced and prestressed concrete structures. Covers material specifications for cement, aggregates, water and admixtures; mix proportioning; durability requirements; reinforcement detailing; and construction practices for all types of concrete structures.
keywords: concrete code of practice design reinforced concrete plain concrete construction durability mix design cement aggregate

title: Concrete Masonry Units — Specification, Part 1: Hollow and Solid Concrete Blocks
scope: Specifies dimensions, physical requirements and testing methods for hollow and solid concrete blocks used in masonry construction. Covers compressive strength, water absorption, dimensional tolerances, and density for load-bearing and non-load-bearing masonry walls.
keywords: concrete blocks masonry blocks hollow blocks solid blocks CMU wall construction load bearing masonry

title: Concrete Masonry Units — Specification, Part 2: Hollow and Solid Lightweight Concrete Blocks
scope: Specifies requirements for hollow and solid lightweight concrete blocks (using lightweight aggregates such as clinker, foamed slag, expanded clay) used in masonry construction. Covers compressive strength, water absorption, dimensional tolerances, and density for non-load-bearing and partition walls.
keywords: lightweight concrete blocks hollow lightweight solid blocks masonry partition wall non-load-bearing aerated

title: Design and Construction of Pile Foundations — Code of Practice, Part 1 Concrete Piles, Sec 1 Driven Cast In-situ Concrete Piles
scope: Code of practice for the design and construction of driven cast in-situ concrete piles used in building and bridge foundations. Covers site investigation, pile design, materials, construction procedure, load testing, and inspection requirements.
keywords: pile foundation driven cast concrete piles deep foundation construction bridge building bored pile

title: Precast Concrete Pipes (with and without Reinforcement) — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for precast concrete pipes (reinforced and non-reinforced) used for drainage, sewerage, culverts, and water mains. Covers materials, dimensions, tolerances, load testing, hydrostatic test, and joint types including rubber ring, tongue and groove, and collar joints.
keywords: precast concrete pipe drainage sewerage culvert water main reinforced concrete pipe stormwater

title: Prestressed Concrete Pipes (including fittings) — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for prestressed concrete pipes (cylinder and non-cylinder type) used for transmission of potable water, industrial water and irrigation water under pressure. Covers dimensions, prestressing wire, concrete mix, hydrostatic test, and joint requirements.
keywords: prestressed concrete pipe water transmission potable water irrigation pressure pipe cylinder pipe water supply

title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for PVC insulated cables used in fixed wiring installations in buildings, industrial premises, and public infrastructure for working voltages not exceeding 1100 V AC. Covers conductor material and dimensions, insulation thickness, current-carrying capacity, voltage test, and insulation resistance.
keywords: PVC cable electrical cable wiring 1100V building wiring electrical installation conductor low voltage fixed installation

title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables — Specification, Part 1: For Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V
scope: Specifies requirements for armoured and unarmoured PVC insulated heavy-duty electric cables for power distribution in industrial plants, public buildings, and underground installations at voltages not exceeding 1100 V. Covers conductor cross-sections, armour, sheath, and electrical tests including high-voltage test.
keywords: PVC cable armoured cable heavy duty power cable electrical installation underground industrial 1100V public building

title: Luminaires — Part 5: Particular Requirements, Section 3: Road and Street Lighting Luminaires
scope: Specifies safety, performance, and photometric requirements for luminaires designed for road and street lighting, including LED street light fixtures. Covers IP protection rating, impact resistance, thermal requirements, photometric characterisation, and colour rendering for outdoor roadway lighting applications.
keywords: street light road lighting luminaire LED street lamp outdoor lighting municipal road highway lighting photometric

title: LED Lamps for General Lighting Services — Performance Requirements
scope: Specifies performance requirements for LED lamps intended for general lighting purposes used in residential, commercial, and public infrastructure. Covers luminous flux, luminous efficacy, colour temperature, colour rendering index, power factor, and lifetime requirements. Mandatory BIS certification product.
keywords: LED lamp LED bulb LED light general lighting energy efficient street lighting luminaire certification BIS

title: Power Transformers — Specification, Part 1: General
scope: Specifies general requirements for oil-immersed and dry-type power transformers including rating, temperature rise limits, insulation levels, dielectric tests, and performance requirements. Applicable to transformers used in power generation, transmission, and distribution systems including distribution transformers for municipal and industrial supply.
keywords: power transformer distribution transformer oil immersed dry type substation high voltage transmission distribution

title: Low Voltage Switchgear and Controlgear Assemblies — Specification, Part 1: Type-tested and Partially Type-tested Assemblies
scope: Specifies requirements for factory-built low voltage switchgear and controlgear assemblies (LV switchboards and distribution boards) for voltages not exceeding 1000 V AC or 1500 V DC. Covers type testing, routine testing, temperature rise, short-circuit withstand, and degree of protection.
keywords: LV switchgear distribution board switchboard controlgear assembly low voltage panel MCC PCC electrical

title: Shell and Tube Type Heat Exchangers — Specification
scope: Specifies design, material, construction, inspection, and testing requirements for shell and tube type heat exchangers used in chemical plants, refineries, power plants, and general industrial processes. Covers tube sheet design, baffles, nozzles, hydrostatic test pressure, and surface finish.
keywords: heat exchanger shell tube industrial process engineering chemical plant refinery thermal equipment

title: Copper Alloy Gate, Globe and Check Valves for Waterworks Purposes — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for copper alloy (gunmetal/brass) screwdown gate, globe, and check valves for water supply and waterworks service, nominal bore DN 8 to DN 50. Covers pressure ratings, body material, hydrostatic test, and seat tightness for plumbing and water distribution.
keywords: valve gate valve globe valve check valve waterworks plumbing water supply copper alloy gunmetal brass

title: Mild Steel Tubes, Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Fittings — Specification, Part 1: Mild Steel Tubes
scope: Specifies requirements for mild steel tubes (ERW and seamless) used for structural purposes, water supply, gas distribution, steam service, and mechanical applications. Covers dimensions, mass, tolerances, chemical composition, mechanical properties, and hydraulic test pressure for light, medium, and heavy class tubes.
keywords: mild steel tube steel pipe GI pipe ERW pipe structural tube water pipe gas pipe plumbing piping seamless

title: Submersible Pumpsets for Clear, Cold Water — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for submersible pumpsets (motor and pump integrated) for lifting clear cold fresh water from deep bore wells and open wells. Covers hydraulic performance, motor efficiency, insulation class, material for impellers and casing, and test methods. Widely used for drinking water supply and irrigation.
keywords: submersible pump borewell pump deep well pump water pump pumpset irrigation drinking water supply agricultural pump

title: Code for Acceptance Tests for Centrifugal, Mixed Flow and Axial Pumps — Class C
scope: Specifies acceptance test methods for centrifugal, mixed flow, and axial flow pumps. Covers measurement of flow rate, head, speed, power input, and efficiency. Class C tests are suitable for routine acceptance testing of pumps used in water supply, irrigation, and general industrial service.
keywords: centrifugal pump acceptance test mixed flow pump axial pump hydraulic test water pump performance

title: Surgical Dressings — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for surgical dressings including absorbent cotton gauze, bandages, and cotton wool used in hospitals and medical facilities. Covers thread count, absorbency, freedom from foreign matter, and sterility requirements for wound care and surgical use.
keywords: surgical dressing gauze bandage cotton wool hospital medical wound care sterile dressings healthcare absorbent

title: Symbols to be used with Information to be Supplied by the Manufacturer — Medical Devices
scope: Specifies symbols to be used with medical device labels and instructions for use, aligned with ISO 15223-1. Applicable to all medical devices including examination gloves, syringes, surgical instruments, and diagnostic equipment. Mandatory labelling requirement for medical devices sold in India under BIS registration.
keywords: medical device labelling symbols healthcare gloves syringes surgical instruments examination gloves hospital

title: Non-absorbable Sterile Surgical Sutures — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for non-absorbable sterile surgical sutures used in wound closure during surgical procedures. Covers material types (silk, nylon, polypropylene, stainless steel), dimensions, tensile strength, needle attachment, sterility, and packaging requirements for hospital and surgical use.
keywords: surgical suture non-absorbable suture wound closure hospital surgical sterile healthcare silk nylon polypropylene

title: Anaesthetic Apparatus — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for anaesthetic apparatus (anaesthesia machines) used in surgical operations in hospitals and medical facilities. Covers gas cylinders, flow meters, vaporisers, breathing circuits, and safety devices. Ensures safe delivery of anaesthetic gases during surgical procedures.
keywords: anaesthetic apparatus anaesthesia machine hospital surgical medical equipment healthcare gas flow meter vaporiser

title: Rehabilitation Equipment — Wheelchairs, Folding, Adult Size — Specification (Second Revision)
scope: Specifies design, performance, safety and test requirements for folding wheelchairs for adults. Covers static stability, dynamic stability, fatigue strength, braking, dimensions, and load requirements. Applicable to wheelchairs for persons with physical impairments requiring mobility assistance.
source: BIS Compendium of Indian Standards on Assistive Products (PDF)
keywords: wheelchair folding adult rehabilitation mobility disability assistive product

title: Specification for Jaipur Foot
scope: Specifies shape, dimensions, material and test requirements for the Jaipur Foot prosthesis. The Jaipur Foot is a below-knee prosthetic foot providing movement in three planes. Made from microcellular rubber. Tests include hardness, relative density, volume loss and shrinkage. Widely used for lower limb amputees in India under the ADIP scheme.
source: BIS Compendium of Indian Standards on Assistive Products (PDF)
keywords: jaipur foot prosthetic limb prosthesis disability amputee lower limb rehabilitation assistive product ADIP

title: External Limb Prostheses and External Orthoses — Requirements and Test Methods
scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for external limb prostheses and external orthoses. Covers material requirements (flammability, biocompatibility, infection control, corrosion resistance), electrical safety for battery-powered devices, surface temperature, sterility, design safety and mechanical structural requirements.
source: BIS Compendium of Indian Standards on Assistive Products (PDF)
keywords: external limb prosthesis orthosis requirements test methods disability rehabilitation assistive product biocompatibility

title: Assistive Products — General Requirements and Test Methods
scope: Specifies general requirements and test methods applicable to all categories of assistive products. Provides a framework for safety, performance, durability and user-related testing applicable across wheelchairs, prostheses, orthoses, walking aids and other assistive technology products.
source: BIS Compendium of Indian Standards on Assistive Products (PDF)
keywords: assistive product general requirements test methods disability wheelchair prosthesis orthosis walking aid

title: Assistive Products for Personal Hygiene that Support Users — Requirements and Methods of Test
scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for assistive products for personal hygiene that support users, including commode chairs, bath/shower chairs, raised toilet seats, grab rails, bath boards, shower tables and diaper-changing tables. Covers stability, static strength, durability, locking devices and braking.
source: BIS Compendium of Indian Standards on Assistive Products (PDF)
keywords: assistive product personal hygiene commode shower chair toilet raised seat grab rail bath disability

title: Accessible Design — Auditory Guiding Signals in Public Facilities
scope: Specifies sound characteristics of auditory guiding signals for persons with visual impairment and blindness in public facilities such as railway stations, airports, government offices, libraries and hospitals. Covers signal generator requirements, loudspeaker arrangement, sound reflection and reverberation.
source: BIS Compendium of Indian Standards on Assistive Products (PDF)
keywords: accessible design auditory signals visual impairment blind public facility railway airport disability accessibility

_comment: ===== AGRICULTURE ===== (3 standards — removed scissors and cable installation which are misclassified)

title: Manually Operated Knapsack Sprayer — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for hand-operated knapsack (backpack) sprayers used in agriculture for application of pesticides, herbicides, and fertiliser solutions on crops. Covers capacity, tank material, pump performance, nozzle discharge rate, strainer, and pressure relief valve requirements.
keywords: knapsack sprayer backpack sprayer agricultural sprayer pesticide herbicide crop protection farm equipment agriculture

title: Methods for Random Sampling — Specification
scope: Specifies statistical methods for random sampling of bulk agricultural produce and commodities for quality assessment and compliance testing. Covers simple random sampling, stratified sampling, systematic sampling, and sample size determination. Used by quality control laboratories and certification agencies for agricultural commodities.
keywords: random sampling agricultural produce quality testing sampling methods statistical sampling food grain commodity

title: Horizontal Centrifugal Pumps for Clear, Cold, Fresh Water — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for horizontal centrifugal pumps used for lifting clear, cold, fresh water in agricultural irrigation, water supply schemes, and drainage. Covers hydraulic performance, materials, impeller design, casing, shaft seal, and test methods for pumps up to 150 mm suction bore.
keywords: centrifugal pump horizontal agricultural irrigation water supply drainage pump clear water fresh water

_comment: ===== FOOD ===== (4 standards — removed IS 784 prestressed concrete pipe)

title: Jaggery (Gur) — Specification
scope: Specifies physical and chemical requirements for jaggery (gur) made from sugarcane juice or palm sap for human consumption. Covers colour, moisture content, total reducing sugars, sucrose content, ash content, and permissible limits for heavy metals and pesticide residues.
keywords: jaggery gur sugarcane food product Indian traditional food quality specification sugar palm

title: Reagent Grade Water — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for reagent grade water used in food processing laboratories, chemical analysis, and pharmaceutical manufacturing. Covers four grades of water (Grade 1 to Grade 4) based on conductivity, pH, silica content, and organic carbon, applicable to food quality testing laboratories.
keywords: reagent water water quality food processing laboratory purified water analytical grade food testing

title: Methods of Sampling of Milk and Milk Products
scope: Specifies methods for taking representative samples of milk, cream, butter, ghee, cheese, and other dairy products for quality testing. Covers sampling equipment, sample size, container selection, preservation, and transport conditions to ensure sample integrity for food safety compliance.
keywords: milk dairy sampling food safety milk products butter ghee cheese quality testing food

title: Condensed Milk and Partly Skimmed Condensed Milk — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for sweetened condensed milk and partly skimmed condensed milk intended for human consumption. Covers total solids, fat content, sucrose content, moisture, bacteriological standards, and packaging requirements for retail and bulk sale.
keywords: condensed milk dairy food product packaged food quality standard tin pack milk sweetened

title: Cotton Terry Towels — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for woven cotton terry towels for domestic and hospitality use. Covers dimensions, mass per unit area (GSM), warp and weft count, tensile strength, tear strength, colour fastness to washing, and moisture absorption. Applicable to hospitals, hotels, and institutional procurement of textile goods.
keywords: cotton towel terry towel textile GSM absorbency colour fastness hospital towel woven cotton institutional

title: Methods for Determination of Count of Cotton Yarns
scope: Specifies standard methods for measuring yarn count (linear density) of cotton yarns including direct and indirect count systems. Covers sampling, conditioning, weighing, and calculation procedures. Used in textile mills, yarn testing laboratories, and quality control for procurement of cotton yarn.
keywords: cotton yarn count yarn testing textile linear density Ne count Tex count yarn quality testing

title: Woven Grey Fabrics for General Use — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for woven grey (unfinished/undyed) cotton fabrics for general industrial and commercial use. Covers weave type, width, weight per unit area, warp and weft count, breaking strength, and dimensional stability before dyeing and finishing.
keywords: grey fabric woven cotton fabric textile industrial fabric grey cloth unfinished fabric breaking strength

title: Methods of Test for Colour Fastness of Textiles and Dyeings
scope: Specifies test methods for evaluating colour fastness of dyed and printed textiles to washing, rubbing, light, perspiration, and water. Covers grey scale ratings and assessment procedures. Used for quality control and procurement acceptance testing of dyed textile materials for uniforms, workwear, and institutional textiles.
keywords: colour fastness textile dyeing dyed fabric washing rubbing light fastness quality testing uniform workwear

title: Automobile Vehicles — Brake Hose Assemblies for Hydraulic Braking Systems used in Motor Vehicles — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for rubber brake hose assemblies used in hydraulic braking systems of motor vehicles. Covers construction, dimensions, burst pressure, proof pressure, expansion under pressure, tensile strength, and compatibility with brake fluids. Critical safety component for passenger vehicles and commercial vehicles.
keywords: brake hose automotive hydraulic brake system motor vehicle safety component rubber hose brake assembly passenger car commercial

title: Automotive Vehicles — Tyres for Passenger Cars
scope: Specifies dimensional and performance requirements for pneumatic tyres used on passenger cars. Covers tyre dimensions, load index, speed rating, plunger energy test, bead unseating resistance, and high-speed performance. Mandatory BIS certification requirement for tyres sold in India.
keywords: tyre passenger car pneumatic tyre automotive vehicle load index speed rating BIS certification tyre specification

title: Automotive Vehicles — Fuel Consumption Measurement — Test Procedures
scope: Specifies test procedures for measuring fuel consumption of passenger cars under simulated road conditions on a chassis dynamometer. Covers test equipment, drive cycle specifications, fuel measurement methods, and reporting. Used for regulatory compliance and comparative evaluation of automotive fuel efficiency.
keywords: automotive fuel consumption passenger car test procedure chassis dynamometer fuel efficiency vehicle testing emission

title: Automotive Vehicles — Lighting, Signalling and Direction Indicator Devices — Requirements and Test Methods
scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for lighting and signalling devices fitted on automotive vehicles including headlamps, tail lamps, brake lamps, direction indicators, and hazard warning devices. Covers photometric performance, colour, marking, and electrical tests for road safety compliance.
keywords: automotive lighting vehicle headlamp tail lamp brake lamp indicator signal device motor vehicle road safety

title: Information Technology Equipment — Safety — Part 1: General Requirements
scope: Specifies safety requirements for information technology equipment including computers, monitors, printers, servers, network equipment, and associated peripherals. Covers electrical insulation, working voltage limits, protection against electric shock, fire enclosure, and thermal cutouts. Mandatory BIS certification for IT equipment sold in India.
keywords: IT equipment computer safety electronics certification BIS registration server laptop printer network equipment information technology

title: Safety of Household and Similar General Purpose Electrical Appliances — General Requirements
scope: Specifies general safety requirements for household electrical appliances and similar general-purpose devices. Covers protection against electric shock, energy, fire, mechanical, thermal, and radiation hazards. Applicable to a wide range of electronic consumer products including mixers, fans, irons, chargers, and domestic appliances.
keywords: household appliance electrical safety consumer electronics domestic appliance BIS certification charger fan mixer iron

title: Specification for Fluorescent Lamp Starters
scope: Specifies electrical and mechanical requirements for starters used with fluorescent lamps. Covers glow-type starters for use with standard fluorescent lamp circuits in commercial, industrial, and domestic lighting applications.
keywords: fluorescent lamp starter electrical component lighting circuit ballast lamp electronics glow starter

title: Plugs and Socket-outlets of Rated Voltage not Exceeding 250 V and Rated Current not Exceeding 16 A
scope: Specifies requirements for plugs and socket outlets with rated voltage up to 250 V AC and rated current up to 16 A for domestic and similar applications. Covers dimensions, contact dimensions, current and voltage ratings, mechanical and electrical tests. The standard Indian three-pin plug and socket specification.
keywords: plug socket electrical outlet 3-pin plug domestic socket power outlet 250V 16A electrical fitting Indian standard

title: Industrial Safety Helmets — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for industrial safety helmets (hard hats) designed to protect the wearer against impact, penetration, and electrical shock in industrial workplaces including construction sites, mines, and factories. Covers materials, construction, performance tests for impact absorption and penetration resistance, electrical resistance, and flammability. Subject to mandatory BIS certification.
keywords: safety helmet hard hat industrial helmet head protection PPE construction site mine factory worker safety

title: Eye Protectors — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for eye protectors used in industrial environments including safety spectacles, goggles, face shields, and welding helmets. Covers optical requirements, mechanical strength, resistance to ignition, field of vision, and marking. Applicable to industrial workers in chemical, construction, welding, and laboratory operations.
keywords: eye protector safety goggles face shield spectacles PPE welding helmet chemical protection industrial safety

title: Insulating Mats for Electrical Purposes — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for rubber insulating mats used as a protective barrier against electrical shock in switchrooms, substations, and near electrical panels and switchgear. Covers dielectric strength, dimensions, surface texture, tear resistance, and marking for use at rated voltages.
keywords: insulating mat rubber mat electrical safety switchroom substation PPE electrical protection high voltage safety

title: Rubber Gloves — Electrical Insulating — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for rubber insulating gloves used by electrical workers for protection against electric shock when working on or near live electrical equipment. Covers dielectric test, mechanical requirements, ozone resistance, and marking for different voltage classes. PPE for electrical safety compliance.
keywords: insulating gloves electrical gloves rubber gloves PPE lineman gloves electrical worker protection high voltage safety

title: Footwear for Electrical Hazard Protection — Specification
scope: Specifies safety footwear providing protection against electrical hazards including electric shock and static discharge in industrial workplaces. Covers insulation resistance, dielectric strength, antistatic performance, and construction requirements for safety shoes and boots used by electrical and electronics workers.
keywords: safety footwear electrical protection shoes ESD boots antistatic footwear worker safety PPE industrial shoe

title: Sulphuric Acid — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for sulphuric acid (H2SO4) in various grades including industrial grade, battery grade, and reagent grade. Covers purity, specific gravity, arsenic content, iron content, chloride content, and nitrate content. Applicable to manufacturers and users of sulphuric acid in chemical processes, battery manufacturing, and laboratory use.
keywords: sulphuric acid H2SO4 industrial acid chemical grade battery acid reagent acid chemical

title: Carbon Tetrachloride — Specification
scope: Specifies purity requirements for carbon tetrachloride (CCl4) used as a solvent and cleaning agent in industrial processes. Covers specific gravity, colour, acidity, water content, and residue on evaporation. Note: Use of carbon tetrachloride is regulated under environmental and health regulations.
keywords: carbon tetrachloride CCl4 solvent industrial chemical cleaning agent laboratory chemical

title: Hydrochloric Acid — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for hydrochloric acid (HCl) in industrial and laboratory grades. Covers acid content (HCl %), specific gravity, colour, iron content, arsenic, sulphate, and heavy metals. Applicable to chemical manufacturing, metal pickling, pH adjustment in water treatment, and laboratory applications.
keywords: hydrochloric acid HCl industrial acid chemical grade pickling acid water treatment chemical manufacturing

title: Sodium Hydroxide (Caustic Soda) — Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for sodium hydroxide (NaOH/caustic soda) in solid flake, pearl, granular, and liquid forms for industrial use. Covers purity, carbonate content, chloride, iron, and heavy metal limits. Used in chemical processing, soap manufacturing, paper pulp production, and water treatment.
keywords: sodium hydroxide caustic soda NaOH industrial chemical alkali soap paper water treatment chemical

title: Technical Supply Conditions for Threaded Steel Fasteners — Part 1: Vocabulary
scope: Covers vocabulary and terminology for threaded steel fasteners (bolts, nuts, screws, and washers). Part of a multi-part standard series (IS 1367) governing mechanical and material properties, tolerances, and testing of all threaded fasteners used in engineering structures, machinery, and construction.

title: Technical Supply Conditions for Threaded Steel Fasteners — Part 3: Mechanical Properties of Fasteners Made of Carbon Steel and Alloy Steel: Bolts, Screws and Studs
